When IPC does not answer, ipc_failure.kind says why: not_configured, no_listener, access_denied (the operating system refused this account; likely a different account or a restrictive ACL, as with a sandboxed client), handshake_failed (the listener did not complete NNG's handshake, so it is probably not KiCad; this takes NNG's 10 s limit, so pass timeout_seconds above 10 to see it), transport_error, or request_failed (the request did not complete and may have reached the endpoint; an explicit KiCad status such as AS_NOT_READY proves receipt, a timeout or malformed reply does not). ipc_failure is null when no kind was established: the Ping succeeded with AS_OK, or this check's own timeout expired first (timed_out: true).","name":"check_kicad_ui"},{"description":"Launch the KiCAD GUI application and optionally open a project file.","name":"launch_kicad_ui"},{"description":"Copy a routing pattern (traces and vias) from one region of the board to another.","name":"copy_routing_pattern"},{"description":"Set per-layer design constraints (e.g. min trace width, clearance) in the sibling .kicad_dru custom rules file.","name":"set_layer_constraints"},{"description":"Measure spacing between two footprints on the requested board. `mode: anchor` (the compatibility default) returns straight-line placement-anchor distance. `mode: courtyard` returns edge-to-edge distance between transformed, authored courtyard bounding boxes for same-side footprints. Neither mode measures pad, trace or copper clearance; use `run_drc` for electrical clearance and `get_component_pads` for pad geometry. Reads the live KiCad board when open, otherwise the saved file, and reports the source.","name":"check_clearance"},{"description":"Create a new KiCAD project at the given path. Requires KiCAD to be running with IPC enabled.","name":"save_project"},{"description":"Rename a KiCAD project: renames the .kicad_pro/.kicad_sch/.kicad_pcb/.kicad_prl files and rewrites the internal references that carry the old name. Renaming the files alone is NOT enough — every symbol instance stores (project \"name\"), and a mismatch there makes KiCAD treat the design as unannotated, losing every reference designator. Equivalent to eeschema's File > Save As. Use dry_run first.","name":"rename_project"},{"description":"Read project metadata from a .kicad_pro file. The compatibility kicad_version is null when those siblings disagree.","name":"get_project_info"},{"description":"Export the schematic and PCB to PDF as a timestamped snapshot/checkpoint. Useful for saving progress before major edits.","name":"snapshot_project"},{"description":"Launch the live schematic viewer. The viewer shows the schematic as SVG and auto-refreshes when the file changes. Use this after placing components so the user can see the schematic in real-time as you edit it.
